news.title: How Ukraine’s drone strikes on Russia crippled the world’s second-largest diesel supplier
news.description: President Donald Trump has blamed Ukraine for surging diesel prices that are hurting Republicans' election chances with the midterms just two weeks away.

news.title: SpaceX stock jumps 10% after earnings beat and Musk hints at Tesla tie-up
